title: Delayed-provider and ambiguous-save acknowledgement fixtures
classification: Existing stale-sync fence and ambiguous-commit save preservation verified with real adapters; no production fix required for these cases.

post_verification_formatting.method: AST equality to exact reconstructed promoted source before whitespace formatting

verified_behavior: A held synthetic provider response spans two real PostgreSQL sessions. Fresh in-flight sync rejects reconnect without changing credentials.

After persisted heartbeat expiry, disconnect or reconnect takes over the slot. Releasing the old response reaches and raises actual SyncSlotLost from the commit fence; old credentials/titles cannot overwrite newer state.

Native save commits real PostgreSQL rows/bytes and then receives a synthetic lost-acknowledgement error. Response is generic 500, separate session sees revision 2 and both committed generations remain readable.
Stale expected-revision retry returns 409 without a new blob. Reconciled retry writes revision 3 while preserving both older generations.
Household network guards block all non-database sockets; legacy collision bytes and unrelated file sentinel survive.
